failedAssertions.reason: The grouped cards and row separators match the contract, but the section labels use fontSize.xs and the theme defines fontSize.xs as 12px instead of the required 11px.
The tools screen has uppercase headers, but they use colors.surface[500] and letterSpacing 0.8 instead of the required stone-5 muted color and letterSpacing 0.6.

Tank Mix has the required 1px selectable borders, primary selected border, 0.08 selected fill, and product-row results card, but the selectable cards use `borderRadius.lg`, which resolves to 24px instead of the 12px radius required by the contract.

LAI renders the dual result layout and interpretation dot, and both values are 24px bold primary green, but the result boxes use a 24px radius instead of the required 14px and the second box uses a 0.10 primary tint instead of the required 0.08.

The reports flow uses warm surface colors, but its main filter/report containers still rely on box-shadow and shadow/elevation styling instead of the bordered Cellar Ledger card treatment required by the contract.
The date fields meet the bordered-card requirement, but the screen does not implement PDF/CSV export chips with an active primary-filled, white-text state.

The farm selector card matches the contract and each log type shows an 8px colored dot plus a category-colored active state, but the type selector is still implemented as large 3-column cards instead of chips.
Shadow and elevation props are still present on add-entry card surfaces and in other forms-tools-settings screens, so the milestone is not yet fully border-only.
